import numpy as np
import torch
from dl_data import make_sensor

x_np, y_np = make_sensor(600, seed=7)
gain = np.random.default_rng(3).uniform(0.5, 2.0, (600, 1)).astype(np.float32)
x = torch.tensor(x_np * gain).unsqueeze(1)
